segments.name: North America
segments.description: Operates Starbucks company-operated and licensed coffeehouses in the U.S. and Canada, selling coffee, tea, beverages and food.
segments.evidence: We have three reportable operating segments: 1) North America, which is inclusive of the U.S. and Canada; 2) International, which is inclusive of China, Japan, Asia Pacific, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Latin America, and the Caribbean; and 3) Channel Development.

segments.name: International
segments.description: Operates Starbucks company-operated and licensed coffeehouses across China, Japan, Asia Pacific, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean.
segments.evidence: Our North America and International segments include both company-operated and licensed stores.

segments.name: Channel Development
products: roasted whole bean and ground coffees
segments.description: Sells Starbucks-branded coffee, single-serve and ready-to-drink products worldwide outside company-operated and licensed stores, largely via the Nestlé Global Coffee Alliance.
segments.evidence: Our Channel Development segment includes roasted whole bean and ground coffees, Starbucks-branded single-serve products, a variety of ready-to-drink beverages, such as Frappuccino ® and Starbucks Doubleshot ® , foodservice products, and other branded products sold worldwide outside of our company-operated and licensed stores.

revenueModel.text: Starbucks earns most of its revenue from retail sales at company-operated coffeehouses, plus royalties, licensing and product sales through licensed stores and the Global Coffee Alliance with Nestlé.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate the majority of our revenues through company-operated stores and licensed stores.
